responsibility: Declares the x86 D front-end hook entry points and binds them into the target D hook macros. This header is the small interface layer between the D front end and i386-d.cc, exposing the routines for D builtin versions, target-info registration, and stdcall-convention support and assigning them to the TARGET_D_* hook definitions for x86 targets.
same_name_distinction: Unlike i386-d.cc, which contains the actual D hook logic, this header is just the interface and hook-binding layer, declaring the x86 D helper functions and mapping them onto TARGET_D_* macros.
